description: This file provides utility functions for parsing MCP URLs, masking URLs, and validating MCP server URLs and names within a React/TypeScript codebase.

methods.name: extractMCPToken
methods.description: Extracts the token and base URL from a provided URL string if it contains the '/mcp/' segment.

methods.name: maskUrl
methods.description: Returns a masked version of the URL, replacing the token part with '...'.

methods.name: getMaskedAndFullUrl
methods.description: Returns an object containing the masked URL and a boolean indicating the presence of a token.

methods.name: validateMCPServerUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a given URL string matches expected URL patterns for MCP servers.

methods.name: validateMCPServerName
methods.description: Validates that the server name does not contain hyphens and suggests using underscores instead.
